evidence.quote: the “de minimis threshold”7 under the Terms and Conditions only applies to virtual assets as defined in section 53ZRA of the AMLO.

“de minimis threshold” refers to the situation where either: (a) the stated investment objective of a fund is to invest in virtual assets or (b) the intention of a fund is to invest 10% or more of its gross asset value (GAV) in virtual assets.

the SFC would not impose the Terms and Conditions on fund managers managing portfolios investing in Tokenised Securities meeting the “de minimis threshold” unless the portfolios also invest in virtual assets meeting the “de minimis threshold”.

value.rationale: The executable meaning correctly preserves the source’s OR structure: either the stated investment objective is to invest in qualifying AMLO virtual assets, or the intention is to invest at least 10% of GAV in those virtual assets. The 1,000-basis-point boundary is exactly 10%, and the GAV denominator is correct. The formula appropriately scopes the question to fund managers and excludes Tokenised Securities from the qualifying virtual-asset conditions, consistent with paragraph 28’s distinction. It adds no holdings requirement or other tests. The conclusion remains conditional on the supplied classifications and runtime uncertainty rules.
